attributes.name: Skulking Vampire
attributes.powers:
The Skulking Vampire is immune to the Mental and Poison traits.

Before the encounter, succeed at a Wisdom or Perception 16 check or the difficulty to defeat the Skulking Vampire is increased by 2, or by 4 if you are the only character at this location.

If undefeated, bury 2 random cards from your discard pile.
